title: 장애예술인 문화예술 활동 지원에 관한 법률 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
title_original: 장애예술인 문화예술 활동 지원에 관한 법률 시행규칙
full_text:
Article 3 (Procedure for Designating a Responsible Agency)
① An agency seeking to be designated as a responsible agency under Article 14(1) of the Act must submit an application for designation, as specified in Form 2 of Annex, to the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism, along with the following documents:
1. Articles of Association
2. Business plan
3. Documents proving compliance with the requirements specified in each item of Article 7(1) of the Act
② Upon receiving the application for designation as described in Article 1, the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism shall verify the company registration certificate in accordance with Article 36(1) of the Electronic Government Act through the shared use of administrative information.
③ The designation certificate for the responsible agency, as issued by the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism in accordance with Article 7(3) of the Act, shall be in Form 3 of Annex.
